protocol.purpose: absolute eight-frame mode-weight calibration; no move-selection gate
protocol.bridge_selection: maximize min(exact mass A, exact mass B) over the fixed grid; tie goes to the smaller clutter rate; valid iff both masses >= 0.10
protocol.interpretation: compare absolute mode A/B signed and joint TV errors to an exact target and iid multinomial baseline; no 8192 run or untouched holdout
